node.statement: Validated-dependency discharge: after nodes 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, and 1.4 are validated, their conjunction gives universal constants C_np<infinity and e_np>0 and, for every admissible algebra, witnesses P_prime and P_doubleprime that are nonvanishing C_np*epsilon_X-projections for the original product, sum exactly to I_X, and obey both cross-product bounds. Existential generalization in the witnesses and universal generalization in the arbitrary admissible algebra therefore prove node 1.5 and hence the root contract.
